title: Legacy 2024 Cloud GPU Spot Instance & Unencrypted Model Bucket Guideline

pages.content: LEGACY GUIDELINE OPS-GPU-2024-09: Research engineers may provision shared g5.12xlarge spot GPU instances in AWS region us-east-1 up to USD 4,500 per month using departmental corporate credit cards without prior FinOps architecture review.

LEGACY GUIDELINE OPS-S3-2024-11: Experimental model weight checkpoints may be staged in bucket s3://legacy-ml-scratch-2024 for up to 14 days with server-side KMS encryption marked optional during benchmark debugging.
